title: James NDEs 6360 NDE 6360
content: EXPERIENCE 1: My experience occurred directly after open heart surgery which occurred on a Monday afternoon. At some point after the surgery, the medical staff was to remove the breathing apparatus and something went wrong. Everything was visual; I could see and hear the staff talking: panic-stricken. All of a sudden, calmness encompassed me. I could see myself floating in a clear liquid (submerged) with fine cottony-silk material, 2-4 inch strips, floating about me. My appearance was without hair and the shine of baby skin. My head began to feel cool like water being rinsed over it. I awoke in an Intensive Care Unit bed with multitudes of individuals assisting me. EXPERIENCE 2 & 3: For the next 2 days, even though sedated, I was fully aware of my surroundings. Each day I was awoken to being moved about on the bed by staff. I saw them usher my wife and son from the area. They attached defibrillators to my chest, I had no pain nor was I in my body: I was above it looking at what was being done. I felt a jolt of pain in my chest and seemed to be back in my body. This happened twice.
